# FnTools.DesignTokens

> F# library implementing DTCG 2025.10 (Design Tokens W3C Community Group) — parse, validate, resolve, emit CSS, and round-trip with Tokens Studio / Penpot. AGPL-3.0.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): What the library does and why, with quick-start examples
- [API Reference](docs/api-reference.md): All public functions with signatures, types, and usage patterns

## Public API entry point

`FnTools.DesignTokens.Api` in [src/FnTools.DesignTokens/DesignTokens.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens/DesignTokens.fs)

Key functions:
- `Api.import` — parse a single DTCG token file
- `Api.importWithResolver` — parse + resolve a multi-set resolver document
- `Api.importTokensStudio` — read Tokens Studio multi-set JSON (flat, all sets merged)
- `Api.importTokensStudioThemed` — read Tokens Studio with per-theme resolution (for CSS multi-mode output)
- `Api.importTokensStudioCombined` — read Tokens Studio with combined multi-group theme selection
- `Api.importTokensStudioRaw` — read Tokens Studio and return ShimResult+ParsedSets for round-trips
- `Api.export` — resolved tokens → DTCG JSON
- `Api.exportTokensStudio` — resolved tokens → Tokens Studio multi-set JSON (requires ShimResult from importTokensStudioRaw)
- `Api.toResolverDocument` — Tokens Studio $themes/$metadata → DTCG ResolverDocument

## Key source files

- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens/DesignTokens.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens/DesignTokens.fs): Public Api module and Primitives submodule — start here
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Foundation/Domain.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Foundation/Domain.fs): Core domain types (TokenValue, ResolvedToken, DimensionUnit, etc.)
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Foundation/Errors.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Foundation/Errors.fs): Error types (ParseError, ValidationError, ResolveError, ImportError)
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssEmitter.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssEmitter.fs): CSS custom-property emitter (emitBlock, emitThemedWith, emitCalcPreserving, DimensionUnitPolicy)
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssIngest.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssIngest.fs): CSS → DTCG token file ingestion
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssAudit.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Css/CssAudit.fs): CSS hardcoded-value audit
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.FSharp/FSharpEmitter.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.FSharp/FSharpEmitter.fs): F# var() constant emitter (typed Tokens module). Renamed from Bindings in v0.12.0 — see ADR-039.
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.TokensStudio/TokensStudio.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.TokensStudio/TokensStudio.fs): Tokens Studio shim (type renames, math eval, HSL eval, $themes) and export
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Format/Format.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Format/Format.fs): DTCG JSON parse and serialize
- [src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Resolver/Resolver.fs](src/FnTools.DesignTokens.Resolver/Resolver.fs): Multi-set resolver document

## Common tasks

**Read Tokens Studio JSON and emit themed CSS:**
```fsharp
let result = Api.importTokensStudioThemed ShimConfig.Default ["Light"; "Dark"] json |> Result.get
let css = CssEmitter.emitThemedWith remPolicy (fun t -> $"[data-theme=\"{t}\"]") result.BaseTokens result.Themes
```

**Round-trip Tokens Studio → export back to Penpot:**
```fsharp
let raw = Api.importTokensStudioRaw ShimConfig.Default json |> Result.get
let (penpotJson, _) = Api.exportTokensStudio raw.ShimResult raw.ParsedSets
```

**Read plain DTCG JSON and resolve:**
```fsharp
let tokens = Api.import json |> Result.get  // (string list * ResolvedToken) seq
```

**Emit F# binding constants:**
```fsharp
let fsharp = FnTools.DesignTokens.FSharp.emit "Tokens" tokens
// generates: module Tokens = let ColorTextMain = "var(--color-text-main)"
```

**Migrate from CSS custom properties to DTCG:**
```fsharp
let ingestResult = CssIngest.ingest "cb" cssText
let dtcgJson = Format.serialize ingestResult.TokenFile
```

## Architecture

Seven layered packages plus a meta-package, all under the `FnTools.DesignTokens` namespace. `open FnTools.DesignTokens` exposes everything.

- `Foundation` — pure domain types, zero non-BCL deps
- `Format` — JSON parse/serialize (System.Text.Json)
- `Validation` — invariant checks (FsToolkit.ErrorHandling for error accumulation)
- `Resolver` — multi-set merge, modifier contexts
- `Css` — CSS emitter, CssIngest, CssAudit
- `FSharp` — F# code emitter (renamed from `Bindings` in v0.12.0; see ADR-039)
- `TokensStudio` — Tokens Studio shim and export
- `FnTools.DesignTokens` — meta-package, public Api module

## Architecture decisions

All significant design choices are in [LOGOS/decisions/](LOGOS/decisions/). Notable ones:
- [ADR-003](LOGOS/decisions/003-io-belongs-to-caller.md): No file I/O in the library — callers supply content as strings
- [ADR-013](LOGOS/decisions/013-library-scope-dtcg-interchange-boundary.md): Library scope is the DTCG interchange boundary
- [ADR-022](LOGOS/decisions/022-tokens-studio-export-preserve-aliases.md): Export preserves aliases, not concrete values
- [ADR-026](LOGOS/decisions/026-shim-annotation-recovery-pattern.md): Shim annotation/recovery pattern for lossless round-trips
- [ADR-029](LOGOS/decisions/029-import-tokens-studio-raw-roundtrip-api.md): importTokensStudioRaw for discoverable round-trip
